title: Chapter 42 — The Custom Builder
intro: The trade book's anchor account — how custom builders work and the service model that wins.

sections.title: Understanding the Builder
sections.content:
Custom builders manage complex, multi-month projects with dozens of subcontractors. They need reliability, consistency, and a supplier who does not create problems. Your job is to be the easiest part of their project.

That means accurate quotes, reliable lead times, coordinated deliveries, and proactive communication when anything changes.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating builder relationships, ask:

Does the salesperson understand the builder's project timeline and pain points?
Are they proactive about communication — or reactive?
Is the builder's experience frictionless — or does every order require extra effort?
